summary: Bug-fix verification for user report 'cari listesinde aşağı doğru geldikçe bazen aralara boşluk atıyor' (random vertical gaps in Cariler list). Code-level fix confirmed: customers.tsx now imports FlatList from 'react-native' (line 4), the mobile branch uses <FlatList> (line 757) with initialNumToRender=15, maxToRenderPerBatch=12, windowSize=11, removeClippedSubviews on Android, updateCellsBatchingPeriod=40, and NO estimatedItemSize/drawDistance on the FlatList. Zero remaining '@shopify/flash-list' imports or <FlashList> JSX in customers.tsx (only a historical comment references it). listRef.scrollToOffset calls (filter reset line 304, ScrollFab up line 800, ScrollFab down line 803) are compatible with the new FlatList. Runtime verification with the only working account (cakmak_ebubekir@hotmail.com/admin — no tenant): app loads, dashboard renders 'HOŞ GELDINIZ, Fatih KONDAL', Cariler tab tap succeeds and renders the 'Veri kaynağı seçilmedi' empty branch (line 642-649) without any red screen, page errors, or FlashList/scrollToOffset console errors. LIMITATION: could not scroll a real cari list because this account has no tenant; the admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (cakmak.ebubekir29@gmail.com/123456) returned 'Giriş Başarısız - Kullanıcı adı/e-posta veya şifre hatalı' on preview, so mid-scroll gap measurement / search-refilter / card-tap→ekstre modal could not be exercised against real data.

critical_code_review_comments: FlatList swap parameters match those already proven on stock.tsx (same fix, same numbers) — consistent with the referenced 2026-05-06 stock fix.
extraData={`${searchQuery}|${filterType}|${filterCities.length}|${filterGroups.length}`} is correctly passed so FlatList re-renders rows when filters mutate — good.

The 'isFiltering' spinner + forced scrollToOffset({offset:0}) on filter mutation (lines 301-307) was originally added to hide a FlashList quirk; it is harmless with FlatList and provides UX continuity, so no need to remove.

rca_of_issue: USER-REPORTED BUG (verified via code): @shopify/flash-list FlashList recycler leaves random empty vertical gaps between rows when a variable-height list is scrolled + mutated (search/filter). Same class of bug already known — fixed for stock list on 2026-05-06 by switching to react-native FlatList. FIX APPLIED (verified in this iteration): customers.tsx swapped FlashList → FlatList with initialNumToRender=15, maxToRenderPerBatch=12, windowSize=11, removeClippedSubviews (Android), updateCellsBatchingPeriod=40; estimatedItemSize & drawDistance removed. FlashList import gone. listRef.scrollToOffset (used by filter-reset effect and ScrollFab up/down) remains API-compatible with FlatList so no runtime error is introduced by the swap.
